text: K4's doubled letters line up in sevens and KRYPTOS has seven letters; the NSA guessed plaintext autokey. Here autokey meets grid moves in which one grid is seven wide, in every column order.

5,040 width-7 column orders with 163 second grids, either first, both directions; ciphertext or plaintext autokey at every lag, after or before the move, on the sculpture's tables; every check is direct.
Settings that pass five or more checks are as common on K4 as on scrambled copies, in all four forms. Closed.
